concepts.proposed_markdown: Metronome's SQL cookbook supplies starting-point queries across customers, events, finalized and draft invoices, invoice-breakdown snapshots, contracts, rate cards, and alerts. Its patterns include `archived_at IS NULL` for non-archived customers, table-global maximum draft snapshots, ID-plus-snapshot breakdown joins, descending `updated_at` ordering for contract overrides, future `ending_before` filtering for rate-card entries, and active webhook-alert predicates. Apply four authorities before production aggregation: only the two breakdown examples filter `environment_type = 'PRODUCTION'` even though one destination spans Production and Sandbox; append-only at-least-once object-storage delivery requires latest-row resolution per primary key before aggregation; `DRAFT_INCOMPLETE` rows can make `COUNT(0)` include rows whose null `total` is ignored by `SUM(total)`; and the rate-card query omits `starting_at`, nullable-end semantics, and version/snapshot selection. A global maximum snapshot is not per-key deduplication or a per-object completeness guarantee, and descending override order is not a one-row selector.
warnings: Preserve the existing database-reference authority for table grain, nullable fields, snapshot behavior, version/effective-time selection, and lifecycle states; the cookbook does not replace it.
Add the intended per-table environment predicate before interpreting non-breakdown cookbook results as Production-only.
For object-storage exports, resolve repeated primary keys to the latest row before aggregating; snapshot filtering and delivery deduplication are separate operations.
Handle DRAFT_INCOMPLETE status and hydration before treating COUNT and SUM as one coherent draft population.
Do not generalize `total/100 AS total_dollars`; [[metronome-currencies-and-custom-pricing-units]] documents USD cents but listed non-USD fiat in whole units.

concepts.proposed_markdown:
> [!warning] SQL cookbook boundaries
> The `Finalized Invoices` queries have no status predicate even though the database reference says `invoice` includes both `FINALIZED` and `VOID` rows. The alert-history query titled `over the last week` has no date predicate. The detailed draft-breakdown query selects six nonaggregated expressions while grouping only by the first two despite the standard-SQL framing. Beyond those raw-page defects, one destination can contain Production and Sandbox while only the two breakdown examples filter Production; append-only at-least-once object-storage delivery requires latest-row selection per primary key; global maximum snapshots do not guarantee per-object completeness; and `DRAFT_INCOMPLETE` rows can be counted while their null totals are ignored by `SUM`. The rate-card count tests only future `ending_before`, omitting start time, nullable-end semantics, and version/snapshot selection. Reconcile status, environment, delivery deduplication, draft hydration, effective time, exported grain, time scope, and target-warehouse grouping before production use.

> [!warning] Cookbook currency alias
> `total/100 AS total_dollars` cannot establish a universal scale. The direct Metronome authority [[metronome-currencies-and-custom-pricing-units]] documents USD in cents and listed non-USD fiat in whole units; select the row's pricing-unit rule before conversion.
warnings: The finalized-versus-void boundary relies on the already-ingested database-reference context; retain its source citation when applying this warning.
Describe the grouping issue as a strict-standard-SQL incompatibility, not proof that every supported warehouse rejects the query under every mode.
Keep environment scope, delivery deduplication, snapshot completeness, draft status, and currency denomination as separate concerns.
Do not call the future-ending rate-card count current without reconciling starting_at, nullable ending_before, and version/snapshot grain.
